meta.title: Origen · Your ancestors, their sky
meta.description: A private place to have your family line researched by hand and to read the birth chart of each ancestor found.

footer.tagline: Origen. Researched by a person, read under the sky they were born under.

landing.headline: Your ancestors were born under a sky, too.
landing.support: Tell us who you know: yourself, your parents, your grandparents. Teresa researches your line by hand in the archives, then publishes what she finds here, with a birth report for every ancestor.
landing.private: Private by default · English and Spanish
landing.step1Title: You tell us who you know
landing.step1Body: A short intake: names, dates and places for you, your parents and your grandparents. Leave blank what you do not know. That is what the research is for.
landing.step2Body: Teresa works through parish books, civil registers and censuses herself. There is no matching engine and nothing is searched automatically.
landing.step3Body: Her findings are published privately for you, with a small family tree and a birth report for each ancestor. Invite relatives to read along.
landing.honestTitle: No instant matches. No public trees.
landing.honest1: Origen will never tell you in thirty seconds that you descend from a king. Research takes the time it takes, and you will be told plainly what is documented and what is still open.
landing.honest2: Most of your ancestors’ birth hours were never written down. Their reports say so, and show what can honestly be known from the date alone: the planets by sign, without a guessed Ascendant.
landing.honest3: Your request and its findings are visible only to you, to Teresa, and to the people you invite to read.

dashboard.emptyBody: Start with what you know about yourself, your parents and your grandparents. It takes about ten minutes.

invites.lead: Create a private link for a relative. Anyone with the link can read the published findings and the birth reports of deceased ancestors. They cannot edit anything, and living people appear by relationship only.
invites.notYet: Links start working once the findings are published.

report.noChart_no_date: A birth report needs a full birth date: day, month and year. None is recorded for this person yet.
report.noChart_partial_date: Only part of the birth date is known so far. A report appears as soon as the day, month and year are confirmed.
report.noChart_out_of_range: Charts are available for births from 1600 onwards.
report.captionFull: Cast for the recorded hour and place
report.captionNoPlace: Cast for the recorded hour · no located place
report.captionNoon: Cast for noon · hour unknown · bar marks the Moon’s range that day
report.risingRole: Rising · how they met the world
report.risingNeedsHour: The Ascendant changes every two hours. Without a recorded birth hour it cannot be known, so none is shown.
report.risingNeedsPlace: Pick the birthplace from the list to locate it and the Ascendant will appear.
report.noonNotice: The birth hour is not recorded, so this chart is cast for noon. Signs are reliable for every planet that did not change sign that day; the Ascendant and houses are left out rather than guessed.
report.utcNotice: The birthplace is not located, so the hour was read as universal time. Locate the place for exact positions.
report.cuspNote: The sign changed that day. If the birth fell on the other side, read {sign} instead:
report.seeSun: Core character. See the reading above.
report.seeMoon: Emotional nature. See the reading above.
report.generational: Shared with everyone born within about {years} years.
report.mayBe: Possibly {sign}: it changed sign that day.
report.aspectsLead: The closest angles between planets, tightest first.
report.aspectsLeadNoMoon: The closest angles between planets, tightest first. The Moon is left out because it moves too fast to place without an hour.
report.compareLead: Set this chart beside another person in the family.
report.method: Method: Western tropical zodiac; geocentric apparent positions of date; whole-sign houses when hour and place are known; aspects by orb (conjunction and opposition 8°, trine and square 7°, sextile 5°). Dates are read in the Gregorian calendar. Before standard time zones, local mean time at the birthplace is used. Readings are interpretive templates, not research findings.

synastry.eyebrow: Synastry · two charts side by side
synastry.unavailable: Both people need a full birth date before their charts can be compared.
synastry.noMoonNotice: At least one birth hour is unknown, so that person’s Moon is left out of the comparison.
synastry.contactsLead: Angles between the planets of {a} and those of {b}, tightest first.
synastry.none: No close contacts between these charts.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.placeholder: This page is a placeholder. The final policy will be written once Origen’s markets and legal basis are decided, and before any public launch.
privacy.p1: Your email and name; the names, dates and places you enter about yourself and your relatives; and the findings Teresa publishes for you.
privacy.p2: You, Teresa, and the people you invite with a reader link. Readers see living relatives by relationship only. Nothing is public and nothing is indexed by search engines.
privacy.p3: We do not sell or share your data, match it against other users’ trees, or search archives automatically with it.
privacy.p4: You will be able to export, correct or delete your data on request. The exact process will be described here.
privacy.p5: Please enter details about living relatives only with their knowledge. Their birth details are never shown to invited readers.
